correctness.rationale: First-force local structure excludes any 3-set (new initial force needs two blue neighbors in triangle-free cubic graph, after first force no further move) and reduces four-sets to local fourth placements; propagating explicit seeds and dihedral symmetries produces seven orbit representatives, six of size 2n and one size n. Intersection-three exchanges are reduced to at most 16 candidate translations and affine congruences An+B=0 mod 2n; |B|<=12 gives uniform stabilization beyond n=13. The seven-by-seven incidence matrix yields degree enumerator, 48n edges, and connectivity through the A-family cycle. Independent exhaustive forcing of every four-set and reconfiguration adjacency for n=6..11 reproduced exactly 13n and degree histogram, and did not substitute for infinity. The n=6 sixth adjacency trace was recomputed using an independently implemented exhaustive construction and length-2-through-6 closed-walk recurrence; both reported trace vectors agreed exactly.
residual_risks: Sixth adjacency traces are a finite-only witness, not an assertion of nonisomorphism for all ladder sizes.
Uniform periodicity of incidence checked by symbolic congruence bound, not by extrapolation from finite n alone.
